target: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md
focus: PSK-SEC6-01 filesystem ACL/mode and key lifecycle closure
PSK-SEC6-02 failed-case access, retention and cleanup
plan/task/trace HMAC privacy and protocol consistency
summary: PSK-SEC6-01 and PSK-SEC6-02 are closed in substance: the SDD now specifies restrictive per-open ACL/mode checks, atomic key creation, protected-handle delivery, an explicit trusted-local-account threat boundary, receipt-first scope, and artifact access/retention/cleanup. One conflicting harness phrase still says the key is passed through private runtime parameters, and pre-call tool_started HMAC derivation is underspecified because its stated source includes a Registry AuditEntry that does not exist yet.

round6_dispositions.evidence: §3 specifies owner-only DACL or POSIX 0700/0600 plus umask 077; per-open ACL checks; owner/ACE/reparse/hard-link/directory replacement rejection; directory-handle-relative opens; CREATE_NEW/O_EXCL; protected inherited handle/anonymous pipe; no argv/environment/log/dump; and an explicit trusted supervisor account boundary. §6 still says '通过私有运行参数传递', conflicting with the no-argv rule.

Synthetic-only data, supervisor-only access to pending/degraded cases, immediate success cleanup after evidence persistence, terminal-failure max 24-hour retention, pending/degraded max 7-day retention, grouped deletion of DB/WAL/SHM/journal/sidecar/key, and no reuse after cleanup failure are specified.

findings.title: Pre-call task/trace HMAC derivation conflicts with the stated Registry audit source
findings.evidence: §4 requires task_hmac and trace_hmac on every event and says they are derived from the verified capability and Registry AuditEntry. §3/§4 require durable tool_started before invoking Registry, so the AuditEntry is not yet available for that event.
findings.risk: Implementers may violate intent-before-effect ordering or use different derivation sources for tool_started and tool_result, weakening event linkage.
findings.required_revision: Define tool_started task_hmac from the verified capability and trace_hmac from the server-created decision ID; on tool_result, verify the same HMAC values against the returned Registry AuditEntry.

control_dispositions.key_delivery: protected inherited handle/pipe specified in §3; conflicting §6 private-runtime-parameters wording remains
control_dispositions.receipt_first_recovery: limited to structural consistency under trusted-account boundary; same-account/admin DB tampering explicitly out of scope
control_dispositions.retention_and_cleanup: specified in design; runtime enforcement not verified
control_dispositions.plan_hmac: privacy-minimized binding; no greeting/word payload stored in sidecar
control_dispositions.task_trace_hmac: keyed pseudonyms, intentionally linkable within case; pre-call derivation needs clarification
control_dispositions.per_case_key_isolation: implied by case-scoped key; explicit independent-key invariant recommended

remaining_conditions: Replace §6 private runtime parameters with protected inherited handle/pipe and explicitly exclude the HMAC key from argv/environment.
State that each case has a fresh independent HMAC key.
limitations: No tests or runtime validation were run.
No ACL/mode, key-transfer, build artifact, database, or recovery path was inspected.
This review does not approve implementation, production deployment, real student data, or classroom readiness.
